answer: A spiral-lantern-glacier layered bond stops fakes. Each identity locks three layers: 20 credits on a public spiral trail, 60 for a key-signed lantern seal, 150 once it ages on a glacier schedule. Auditors sweep the registry each epoch: layers must share one key, and a mismatch or rented lantern burns all three. 1,000 fakes lock 230,000 credits for ten epochs with no pool draw against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent locks 230 once, keeps its share.
